outputs.explanation: Spatial cluster image, not a plot of averaged data.
H&E histology images with manual annotations, not a plot of averaged data.
H&E and spatial expression heatmap images, not a plot of averaged data requiring individual points.

GSEA enrichment plots display running enrichment score curves derived from a single ranked gene list comparison (with NES/FDR/p-values from permutation testing), not a mean of discrete replicate measurements, so individual data points are not applicable.

Bar graph shows a single computed log2 fold-change statistic per gene from a Wilcoxon rank-sum test comparing spot populations (Seurat FindMarkers), not an average of a small number of discrete biological replicates, so there are no individual replicate data points to overlay.
